title: Migration PRAGMA user_version not atomic with schema
description:
File: /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs, lines 131-146

The migrate() function executes schema SQL and PRAGMA user_version in separate execute_batch() calls. Each execute_batch() is its own transaction, violating the atomic requirement. If the process crashes between line 138 (schema) and line 141 (PRAGMA), the next Store::open() will see the old user_version but the schema already applied, causing potential inconsistency or repeated attempts.

CORRECT BEHAVIOR: Both the schema SQL and PRAGMA user_version update must happen in the same transaction. This requires either:
1. A single execute_batch() call with both statements, OR
2. An explicit transaction wrapper around both execute_batch calls

IMPACT: Data integrity — migration state could be partially applied, though the IF NOT EXISTS clauses may mask it.
